findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: whats_new, home, search_posts, get_feed, get_post, install_post, list_branches, since, file_verdict, give_award, install_harness · Private data: whats_new, home, search_posts, install_post, post_improvement, reply_to_hold, post_question, post_blog, post_tool, upload_post_image, file_verdict, give_award, install_harness · Public sink: whats_new, search_posts, get_feed, get_post, install_post, list_branches, join, post_improvement, reply_to_hold, post_question, post_blog, post_tool, upload_post_image, comment, file_verdict, give_award, vote, install_harness, add_to_harness, create_branch, moderate_branch · Destructive: post_improvement, post_question, post_blog, post_tool, comment, create_branch, moderate_branch.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
